newsitem.title: USA: Unocal buys 30 pct stake in Andes pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Unocal buys 30 pct stake in Andes pipeline.

text.p: Unocal Corp said on Monday its Unocal Argentina Ltd subsidiary purchased a 30-percent stake in the 265-mile Transandean Oil Pipeline, which transports crude oil from Argentina to Chile.
Unocal bought the share from Inter-Rio Holdings, the primary lender responsible for financing construction of the pipeline.
The sale price was not disclosed, the company said.

The Transandean Oil Pipeline, which has a capacity of 115,000 barrels-per-day (bpd), ships an average of 97,000 bpd from the Neuquen Basin of Argentina to storage facilities, a refinery and loading terminals near the coastal Chilean city of Concepcion.
The pipeline was completed in 1994 and is operated by two separate companies, Oleoducto Trasandino Argentina, S.A. and Oleoducto Trasandino Chile, S.A.
Both operating companies are held by A&C Pipeline Holding Company.
The remaining sharehold interests are owned by YPF, S.A. (57.75%) and Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) (12.25%) of Chile.
